value.body: An art teacher teaches drawing, painting and craft to school students, or to learners at an art studio or hobby class. Private schools, government schools and art studios hire art teachers. A typical day is taking classes across grades, preparing materials and assessing student work.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BFA, or a diploma in fine arts or art education

items.label: Common materials
items.value: Pencil, charcoal, watercolour, acrylic, clay and craft materials

items.label: Students in BFA programmes
items.note: Roughly flat at ~30,000 from 2021-22 to 2023-24; not all become teachers

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Private schools and studios often hire BFA graduates directly after a demo class and portfolio review. Government school posts commonly ask for a teaching qualification such as a B.Ed or an art teacher diploma, and sometimes a teacher eligibility test; the exact requirement is in each recruitment notice.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Lesson planning for different age groups

value.title: At a glance
items: Many schools have one or two art posts, so openings are limited.
Some teachers also run private classes or sell their own work.
An MFA or B.Ed widens options in teaching.
